plain_english_policy: This bill designates specific segments of U.S. Highway 78 and Alabama Highway 46 in Cleburne County as memorial highways to honor two late law enforcement officers, Lieutenant Ralph Byron Bentley and Lieutenant Greg Merrill.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would officially rename portions of existing state infrastructure (U.S. Hwy 78 from mile marker 175-180; Ala. Hwy 46 from mile marker 0-5) to serve as memorials for two deceased officers who served the City of Heflin.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey sponsored this bill affirmatively advancing the memorial designation.
evidence_quotes: NAMING A PORTION OF U.S. HIGHWAY 78 IN CLEBURNE COUNTY IN MEMORY OF LIEUTENANT RALPH BYRON BENTLEY AND A PORTION OF ALABAMA HIGHWAY 46 IN CLEBURNE COUNTY IN MEMORY OF LIEUTENANT GREG MERRILL.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA, BOTH HOUSES THEREOF CONCURRING, That we herein recognize a portion of U.S. Highway 78 in Cleburne County as the Lieutenant Ralph Byron Bentley Memorial Highway and a portion of U.S. Highway 46 in Cleburne County as the Lieutenant Greg Merrill Memorial Highway
